Determines target ground velocity (m/s) in 'speed' pacing mode. Drives aerodynamic drag (proportional to v^3) and moving time (t = d / v).

In 'speed' mode, rider holds velocity into headwinds/climbs causing leg power and carb oxidation spikes; in 'effort' mode, rider caps power at targetEffortWatts and slows down, protecting glycogen reserves.

Air density (rho). Drives aerodynamic drag force (0.5 * rho * CdA * v_air^2 * v_ground).
